question.name: The Great Water Argument
question.text: Two farmers disagree about how best to carry water to a thirsty patch of ground near the Tree.

a1_1.text: A channel of carefully fitted stones proves efficient.

text_only.reason: food OR tech: the other page gives the tech

a1_2.text: A channel of carefully fitted stones proves efficient.

text_only.reason: food OR tech: the other page gives the food

a2.text: Both methods fail because neither farmer noticed a blocked inlet.

a3.text: A child combines the ideas and succeeds. The farmers reluctantly share the credit.

b1.text: The builders propose a sturdy solution and gain respect.

b2.text: Their elaborate design takes longer than simply carrying the water by hand.

b3.text: The builders admit the farmers know the ground better and work together.
